title: This AI Council Destroyed My Decision Making Process
description:
Most people use Claude to get one agreeable answer. This free Claude skill, the council, spins up 5 AI agents (contrarian, first principles thinker, expansionist, outsider, executor) that attack your decision from different angles, peer-review each other, and a chairman agent synthesizes one clear recommendation with a next step. It's based on Andrej Karpathy's LLM Council, adapted for Claude Code skills. Great for anyone using Claude AI for real decisions instead of a yes-man. Full setup and the exact trigger phrases are in the guide below.

Get the skill and setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GqpUG1K2sO55h8QNSUgbHjK8-jbPi4jE/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
